title: Intro loader (load screen)
retrievalIneligibleReason: Preloader overlay: fixed full-viewport intro shown once per session before the page; it is runtime chrome, not page content, so it is excluded from retrieval.

structure.root: div.loader[aria-hidden=true] fixed inset 0, z-index 150, background surface.paper, flex column space-between, padding 28px gutter; display:none unless html.js; display:none under html.no-loader
structure.topRow: .loader__top: brand label <span> + .loader__file tag <span>; mono 11px, ls .14em, uppercase, text.muted
structure.mid: .loader__mid absolutely centred, flex column gap 28px: svg.loader__seal + .loader__status

parts: defs path#sealPath (circle r47 as two arcs) for the ring text
circle.seal-ink r62 filled currentColor, starts opacity 0 (animates to .12)
text.seal-text Geist Mono 7.6 on textPath href #sealPath, textLength 292, lengthAdjust spacing, starts opacity 0

structure.status: .loader__status mono 12px ls .14em uppercase accent.olive, min-width 22ch, centred; text steps at counter thresholds
structure.bottomRow: .loader__bot: .loader__count (display font, clamp(64px,9vw,128px), lh .8, ls -.02em, tabular nums, text.muted; text "00".."100") + foot label span
structure.bar: .loader__bar absolute bottom, 2px, border.default track; span accent.olive scaleX 0->1 origin left
structure.panels: .loader__panels absolute inset 0, flex, 6 x <i> flex:1 surface.night, transform-origin 50% 100%, start scaleY(0); exit translateY(-101%)

endState: display:none; sessionStorage dc-intro=1; smooth scroll started; hero intro already running (started at T0+2780ms)
